limits: Original failed scores and expectations are preserved.
PUB07 original offer-date acceptance passed 3/3; unrelated behavior regressed relative to separately measured A5.
Required opening recording disclosure is retained; a judge conflating that disclosure with a promise acknowledgement is not a reason to remove it.
Post-run ledger capture is corroborating evidence, not a fresh historical per-turn snapshot.
Text simulations do not qualify voice, ASR or hidden-case coverage.
